name: Pokelike
summary: Pokelike is a browser-based Pokémon roguelike where you explore procedurally generated dungeons, capture and train wild Pokémon, and build a team to survive increasingly difficult floors. Each run is unique thanks to random layouts, encounters, items, and events, with permadeath on team wipe — forcing you to improve your strategies run after run. Faithful turn-based combat, evolutions, and deep team management make it an addictive and replayable experience playable directly in any web browser.
